Container.Name: PASTA
Container.Overview: PASTA - Plex Audio & Subtitle Track Automation
Container.Description: PASTA (Plex Audio & Subtitle Track Automation) connects to your Plex Media Server to let you inspect detailed audio and subtitle stream metadata, batch-update tracks across episodes, seasons, shows, collections, or libraries, and automatically sync TV show language preferences in the background across all of your devices and users.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying the tool? Consider adding to my coffee funds :)

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for PASTA Server Mode database, encrypted tokens, and logs

Config.Name: PASTA Mode
Config.Description: Operating mode: 'server' (default, includes background automation and multi-user support) or 'client' (stateless browser-only web app)

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to force verbose diagnostic logging to container stdout (can also be toggled live in the web UI)
